query: Explain Section 22 on unsoundness of mind.

gold_references.label: Section 22
gold_references.role: act of person of unsound mind incapable of knowing the nature or wrongfulness of the act

required_points: Section 22 provides that nothing is an offence done by a person who, at the time of doing it, by reason of unsoundness of mind, is incapable of knowing the nature of the act or that he is doing what is either wrong or contrary to law.
The unsoundness must exist at the time of the act and must render the person incapable of knowing the nature or wrongfulness of the act.
optional_points: Mere unsoundness of mind is not enough; the person must be incapable of knowing the nature of the act or that it is wrong.
forbidden_points: Any person with a mental illness is automatically exempt.
Section 22 protects persons who are voluntarily intoxicated.

notes: Direct lookup. Section 22 is the insanity defence under BNS general exceptions.
